name: Composition Artifact
description: Placeable wrapper around primitive_stack.build(cfg). Reads a JSON config (layout, palette, sequence of shapes/colors/sizes) and builds the resulting Bauhaus-descended composition as a Node3D in 3D space. Mirrors the primitive_stack grammar's research-render pipeline.
theoreticalGrounding: Same federated rendering pattern as facade_builder, lsystem_artifact, etc.: each grammar's existing build function becomes a placeable artifact.

composition_artifact.name: Composition Artifact
composition_artifact.description: Placeable primitive-stack composition. Parameters: config_path (JSON config), grammar (default 'primitive_stack'). Loads the config and calls PrimStack.build(cfg).
composition_artifact.qfep_connection: F_order: structured arrangement of primitives — Bauspiel, Vignelli, Becker as composition vocabulary.
